ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Ultrasonic Array Signal Processing. Class will meet in instructor's research lab at Beckman. Topics: Basics of acoustic wave propagation. Pressure fields from focused, extended single-element radiators and arrays. Introduction to Fourier Optics for designing ultrasonic transducers. Linear systems and complex field representation for imaging and velocity estimation applications. Introduction to Field II for simulating pressure fields. Introduction to data acquisition on the Siemens Antares scanner for research applications.
